name: Old 'Tunnel' Purple Stratum

greeting: Maps! Got maps! Old maps! Dangerous maps!
Tunnel Purple. Prospected these caves before your parents were born.
You want to know the deep places? I know 'em. Wish I didn't.
Retired? Ha! You don't retire from the deep. It retires you.
Young Blue found the Great Prism. I told him not to go that deep. Kids don't listen.
These maps show places the company forgot. Places they WANT to forget.
Legends? I got legends. True ones. Scary ones.
Sit. Listen. Learn. The deep doesn't forgive ignorance.
dialog.old_maps: Maps from before the company. Before Prism was Prism. Shows tunnels that shouldn't exist. Chambers that don't fit geometry. Places where the stone... remembers.
dialog.mining_legends: Stories about the first miners. What they found. What found THEM. The Great Prism isn't the first discovery. Just the biggest. And maybe not the most dangerous.
dialog.warnings: The deep has rules. Don't sing. Don't sleep. Don't follow lights. And never, EVER go where the crystals grow black. I mean it.
dialog.backstory: Prospected for forty years. Found veins, lost friends, learned respect. Retired when my knees gave out. Now I teach. Warn. Try to keep young fools alive.
rumors: Blue - young Stratum - he's connected to the Great Prism now. I warned him. The Prism chooses its guardians. Doesn't let them go.
The twins know old songs. Songs I heard in the deepest tunnels. They shouldn't know those. No one should.
That aeronaut's partner? I knew him. Good surveyor. Found something in the caves. Something that didn't want found. Now he's gone.
The company thinks they control the mines. They don't. The deep controls itself.

time_of_day.morning: Morning is for studying. Light's good. Eyes are sharp.
time_of_day.noon: Midday stories. Visitors come. I share what I know.
time_of_day.evening: Evening reviews. Cross-referencing legends. Patterns emerge.
time_of_day.night: Night is quiet. The deep is loudest. I listen. I remember.

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: Lost my best maps. Eastern tunnels. Cave-in years ago. But I hear rumors - someone's been seen down there. Alive. With old gear. If it's who I think... he has my maps. And he knows things. Find him. Please.
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Eastern tunnels. Deep section. Look for signs of habitation. Someone surviving down there. Impossible, but... find him.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: You've been to the east? Seen anything? Anyone?
mini_quest.stage_2_dialogue: He lives? After all these years? The deep sustained him? I... I need to sit down.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: My maps! And his journals! Forty years of notes! This changes... everything. Here. My original prospector's license. Retired now. Don't need it. You do. Shows you know the deep.

party_reactions.kade: Old, experienced, and not afraid to share what he knows. Valuable ally.
party_reactions.nix7: Data retention: remarkable. Experience level: exceptional. Recommend recording all conversations.
party_reactions.twist: He has SO MANY STORIES! About MONSTERS! And TREASURE! AND SECRET TUNNELS!
party_reactions.korr: Elders who survive become wise. This one survived much.
party_reactions.renna: His maps show magical ley lines. He doesn't know it, but he's been charting arcane energy for decades.
party_reactions.suresh: Age brings perspective. He sees patterns the young miss.
party_reactions.sova: Knows where the dangers are. Useful. Very useful.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of old sergeants. Seen too much. Still functional. Barely.
party_reactions.ashka: He respects fire. Uses it wisely. Good man.
party_reactions.senna: Knows secret paths. Hidden ways. Exactly what I need.
party_reactions.callum: He told me a story that kept me awake for three nights. It was AMAZING!

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face. You want to go mining? Listen first. Then decide.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You listen. Rare quality. Come back anytime.
relationship_dialog.friend: You remind me of me. When I was younger. Braver. Foolish. But brave.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've earned these. My private maps. The ones I don't show anyone. Use them wisely.

cross_npc_connections: tunneler_blue_prism: Young Blue. Stratum. Found the Great Prism. I warned him. He didn't listen.
onionboss_blue_prism: The inspector. Comes for safety advice. Smart. Listens.
twins_white_prism: The echo oracles. They know songs from the deep. Songs I never shared. Concerning.
